description.value: Arabisk Mediterranean Cuisine is a Lebanese and Mediterranean restaurant in Prince Rupert, BC, helmed by Head Chef Tehama Al Shamandi, whose background blends traditional Lebanese techniques with modern culinary innovation. The restaurant offers dine-in table booking, a special buffet service, catering for events and weddings, and online ordering with home delivery. A second location operates in Terrace, BC, making this a growing regional presence for authentic Mediterranean food in Northern BC.
